items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Like Jerry Lewis does some time -- he tries to go into the magicals of the -- imagination -- imaginaries.

ctx.x: I see. It was sort of a comical kind of thing? Chuck and Chuckles would come out and do their thing -- the band would be playing, you'd pretend like you were conducting it?
Yes, that's it. Like Jerry Lewis does some time -- he tries to go into the magicals of the -- imagination -- imaginaries.
Would you tap dance when you conducted?
